claim_text: On 11 March 2025, NIST selected HQC for standardization and expected a finalized standard in 2027.

evidence.passage: NIST plans to issue a draft standard incorporating the HQC algorithm in about a year, with a finalized standard expected in 2027.
evidence.source_title: NIST Selects HQC as Fifth Algorithm for Post-Quantum Encryption
evidence.provenance_basis: Publisher-hosted document located; source independence has not been established.
